ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Bata India Limited has issued a routine regulatory notice announcing a Board Meeting scheduled for November 3, 2026. The primary purpose of this meeting is to consider and approve the company's unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. This intimation signals an imminent release of the company's Q2/H1 earnings, which will be a material event for investors. There are no apparent red flags or unusual activities indicated in this standard compliance disclosure.
